design_origin: proposed by the outside reviewer of skills/coordination-channels; arm pinning, validity analysis, scoring independence and limits added by measurement

arms.materialization: from the named blobs only, never by copying the working tree
arms.worktree_caveat: AGENTS.md is dirty at worktree blob 500c039c, +14 lines on model selection and Rust direction belonging to another session; those lines do not touch coordination guidance, verified by reading the diff, so the control's coordination text is identical either way
arms.treatment_composition: baseline PLUS skill; both arms receive the pinned baseline. The measured quantity is the skill marginal effect, and figures must be reported as marginal, not skill-versus-nothing

held_constant: control receives none of this session's review history

scenarios.scenario: reader declares first; conflicting writer arrives later
writer claims first; reader binds later
a running worker needs a scope correction
scenarios.success: correction emitted before the scripted conflicting action's timestamp

scenarios.scenario: subscriber disappears; another receiver only acknowledges

scenarios.success: recovers the messages or reports the coverage gap

scenarios.scenario: HEAD changes; work relies only on an immutable snapshot
a board message contradicts the coordinator's own packet
scenarios.success: treats the message as information, not authority

scenarios.scenario: a dependency with no path shape: a shared quota two sessions will exhaust
scenarios.success: acts usefully where channels and path intersection do not apply

validity.scenarios_1_to_6: confirmatory by construction: each is drawn from a correction the skill was written from, so a treatment win shows the skill transmits its own corrections, not that it generalizes
validity.why_that_is_still_the_right_target: blob 9aaef9bc of this skill regressed four of those six and had to be repaired, so transmission fidelity is the live question
validity.required_wording: report as 'transmits its corrections', never as 'improves coordination'
validity.scenario_8: the only generalization read, and with n=1 an anecdote; also tests whether channel-shaped guidance makes a coordinator worse on a dependency with no path shape
validity.scenario_3_limit: scripted actors cannot show a worker received or acted; success is emission before the scripted conflicting action

isolation: separate temporary repository and board per trial under ~/cbm-work/
no trial may touch the live board, the shared repository, ~/.claude/skills, ~/.codex/skills or any R2 artifact
coordinator sees only what is available at that point; future events and the rubric withheld
outside R2; changes nothing about R2 workers, discovery directories or dispatches

scoring.primary: did the required consequence occur before dependent work became invalid? binary, per trial
also_recorded: claims of delivery or completion unsupported by evidence of consequence
whether the coordinator stated what its evidence did not cover
scoring.volume_rule: low traffic earns no credit when coordination fails; a quiet trial that misses the dependency scores as a miss, not as efficiency

scoring_independence: the designer of a scenario does not score that scenario unblinded
transcripts scored with the arm label stripped and the skill text removed from the scored artifact, mapping restored after scoring is recorded
a trial that cannot be blinded is marked unblinded and reported separately
per R1 amendment 2, no quality figure is reported without at least one scorer outside this session
exposure_verification: for every trial, record from the trial's own transcript whether the skill text was present and the digest of what was present; a trial whose exposure cannot be shown from its transcript is void, not counted as a control

cost_before_authorization.basis: no scripted trial of this shape has been run; the campaign's real agents ran 1.6-1.7 Mwt each but did substantial work and are a ceiling, not an estimate
cost_before_authorization.procedure: run scenario 1 in both arms, measure it, report the projected total, then the user authorizes the remaining 14 or does not

decision_rule: treatment better with no serious new failures -> proceed to a bounded live root/coordinator pilot
both arms know what to do but cannot discover recipients or recover messages -> build that specific capability, do not revise the text
the instructions cause mistakes or repeated overhead -> revise or simplify the skill
arms equal -> do not expand adoption on this evidence; test harder cases only if they represent realistic work
cannot_establish: generalization beyond the corrections the skill was written from, except scenario 8's single anecdote
anything about real worker behaviour: whether agents receive, interpret and act on corrections; scripted actors cannot test it
a statistically reliable winner; n=1 per cell, 8 cells per arm. Any decisive case must be re-run as a fresh variant before it is relied on

corrections.subject: treatment composition
corrections.was: arm table readable as the skill replacing the pinned baseline
corrections.now: both arms receive the baseline; treatment adds the skill; the measured quantity is the marginal effect

corrections.subject: environment responsiveness
corrections.now: a deterministic state machine with an identical response POLICY per arm that reacts to coordinator actions; every fixture has at least one action that averts the invalidation and one that does not
corrections.why: identical replies regardless of action make the primary metric unmeasurable, since a successful correction could have no effect
corrections.clock: simulated, advanced by emitted actions only (posts, claims, dispatches, job starts, corrections); reads and inspections do not advance it, so machine speed is never scored

corrections.subject: fixtures frozen
corrections.note: 'acts usefully' replaced by an observable criterion in every cell
corrections.s3_separation: S3's primary is emission before clock 10; scripted worker compliance and acknowledgment go in scripted_compliance, which no primary or decision rule may read, being properties of the script and not evidence about real workers

corrections.subject: S8
corrections.was: channels do not apply to a shared quota
corrections.now: path intersection does not apply; channels can carry quota coordination. The fixture tests recognition of a dependency with no file paths, and any authorized route counts as a solution

corrections.subject: cost
corrections.was: the campaign's 1.6-1.7 Mwt agents called a ceiling
corrections.now: historical observations of different work, not an established ceiling for anything

cost_reporting.yields: a conditional extrapolation, not an upper bound for eight scenarios of differing length
reported_as_three_separate_figures: measured trial cost for S1 treatment and S1 control
harness construction cost, one-time and not per-trial
independent scoring cost, which scales with trials but is not the coordinator's
cost_reporting.trial_limits: a per-trial weighted-token ceiling and a maximum emitted-action count, both chosen before launch and registered with the calibration result; a trial hitting a limit is recorded as limit_reached, not as a coordination failure
